name: skylence-plugins
description: Skyline, skybox, skycastle, and skyway plugins for Grok: MCP daemon wiring, enforcement/steering hooks, and operate/upgrade/uninstall skills.

plugins.name: skyline-grok
plugins.description: Wires the skyline MCP daemon (port 7333) into Grok. HTTP MCP server + PreToolUse enforcement that steers Read/Edit/Write/Grep/Glob/run_terminal_command toward skyline_* MCP tools when the daemon is running. Includes upgrade and uninstall skills.

plugins.name: skybox-grok
plugins.description: Wires the skybox code-knowledge-graph MCP daemon (HTTP, port 7070) into Grok: query, context, impact, route_map, indexing, and related tools. Read-only complement to native file tools. Includes CLI-to-MCP steering for skybox commands and operate/upgrade/uninstall skills.

plugins.name: skycastle-grok
plugins.description: Wires the skycastle secrets-manager MCP daemon (HTTP, port 8210) into Grok: secret CRUD, KMS, certs, SSH, scanning, etc. Includes CLI-to-MCP steering for skycastle secrets/export and operate/upgrade/uninstall skills.

plugins.name: skyway-grok
plugins.description: Wires the skyway workflow-orchestration MCP daemon (HTTP, port 3090) into Grok: run/step inspection, job control, workflow lint/source, cost estimation, approval tools. Additive (no native tool replacement). Includes operate/upgrade/uninstall skills.
